scope: Targeted native client-home polish; not full application completion.

source_evidence.food_home: mobile/src/FoodBusinessHome.tsx renders the verified public menu and listing-bound contact paths. It does not show a menu call-to-action when there are no published menu rows. The uploaded logo is used when present; the business name is not duplicated as a second logo.
source_evidence.hotel_home: mobile/src/hospitalityCatalog.ts projects bounded room, dining, venue and amenity details only from the listing's same-official-site links; no inventory or availability is asserted.
source_evidence.profile_routing: mobile/src/Profile.tsx routes restaurant/bakery and musician profiles to their dedicated homes.
source_evidence.design: Compact mobile hierarchy and reduced repeated copy, based on the user-provided design references; OS text scaling remains supported.

render_evidence.result: 15 actual-component browser cases pass at compact phone, large accessibility text, landscape and desktop dimensions in light/dark states.
render_evidence.captures: Generated screenshots were visually inspected from /tmp/zoi-food-home-20261016-r6 and /tmp/zoi-mobile-sector-20261016-r3. They validate sparse/no-verified-photo states and a controlled hotel catalogue fixture. These are not live-data or image-rich evidence.

exercised: food menu display/search and empty-menu recovery
hotel source link validation and listing-bound booking callback
hotel identity layout with and without a verified hero image
not_proven: physical iOS or Android install/device acceptance
live hotel inventory or connected booking provider
every profile family and the full 153-screen/987-requirement scope

completion: Partial. Food business and hotel receive dedicated improvements, but organization and directory profiles still use shared generic homes, home-services needs its own service journey, owner-published layouts share a renderer, and other native family journeys still require source-backed and device acceptance.
